description: This file defines a REST API class for managing tags within the Superset project, including endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and managing favorites of tags.

classes.name: TagRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class for managing tags, including CRUD operations, bulk actions, and favorite management within the Superset application.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new tag based on provided schema data.

methods.name: bulk_create
methods.description: Bulk creates multiple tags and associated objects.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates an existing tag identified by primary key.

methods.name: add_objects
methods.description: Adds tags to a specific object, creating new tags if necessary.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Deletes a specific tag from an object.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Bulk deletes tags, removing all tagged objects with those tags.

methods.name: get_objects
methods.description: Retrieves all objects associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: favorite_status
methods.description: Retrieves favorite status of tags for the current user.

methods.name: add_favorite
methods.description: Marks a tag as favorite for the current user.

methods.name: remove_favorite
methods.description: Removes a tag from the current user's favorites.
